## The ask

What leadership or the team asked for, in their words.

## What was actually wrong

The real bottleneck, which is often different from the ask.

## How I found out

Who you sat with, what you mapped, what the data showed.

## Options and the call

The two or three options you weighed and why you picked the one you did.

## What I built

The system, step by step. Show the important code inline.

## What stayed familiar, what went away, what people had to learn

What the team still does the same way, what manual work disappeared, and anything new they had to pick up.

## Result

What changed. Label every figure as measured, estimated, or illustrative.

## What I'd change

With hindsight, what you'd do differently.
